task:
Colony Planner: replace the paged facility picker with a Raven-style tabbed list. File: apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/FacilityPicker.svelte (plus tests). This supersedes request plan-picker-port-grouping-20261101, which never ran.

Owner report (production, 2026-11-01): the picker pages 6 facilities at a time in catalogue order, which interleaves orbital ports, surface settlements, installations and outposts. On a landable body page 1 shows Coriolis, Dodecahedron and four surface settlements; Ocellus and Orbis are on page 2, T1 outposts on pages 4-5, Port and surface outposts on pages 5-6. The owner called 6+ pages "nuts" and asked for Orbital / Ground choices and a list, like Raven Colonial's site picker.

Required design (modelled on Raven Colonial's picker the owner showed):
1. Tabs across the top: "Both", "Orbital", "Surface". Default to "Orbital" when no Primary Port exists yet or the location is not landable; otherwise "Both". The Surface tab is disabled (with a title explaining why) when location.is_landable === false. Asteroid Base still appears only when location.has_rings (keep facilityFitsLocation as the fit rule). Tabs are a proper tablist with arrow-key navigation and aria-selected.
2. ONE scrolling list, no pages at all. Remove pageNumber and the Previous/Next buttons. The list has a bounded max-height and scrolls inside the picker.
3. Order within the list, under small section headings: Orbital starports (Coriolis, Asteroid Base, Dodecahedron, Ocellus, Orbis in that order, matching Raven), Orbital outposts (T1 ports), Orbital installations, then Surface ports (Port, then T1 surface outposts), Surface settlements, Surface hubs. Use is_port, tier, category and allowed_location; within a section sort by tier descending then name except the fixed starport order. Empty sections are hidden. In "Both" orbital sections come first.
4. Compact rows, one line each where width allows: facility name (the button), a tier chip, and the CP cost/earn right-aligned (e.g. "-7 T3 · +1 T2" style, using the existing server preview values; keep the existing 'Evaluating CP…' / 'CP preview unavailable' / 'Choose a Primary Port first' states). Show the "Requires: ..." line only when the facility has prerequisites. Optionally show layout names as small tags when raven-import.ts's BUILD_TYPES table maps them to the facility id; skip this if it needs new data.
5. Keep server CP previews bounded: never more than 6 preview requests in flight. Request previews only for rows scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver on the list's scroll container), debounced as today, cancelled with the existing AbortController pattern when the plan, location, tab or search changes. Do NOT use catalogue constants as cost stand-ins (keep the existing comment's rule). jsdom has no IntersectionObserver: feature-detect it and fall back to previewing the first 6 visible rows.
6. Keep the "Find a facility" search box; it filters within the current tab. Keep "No matching facilities." and the Primary Port rule (non-ports disabled until a port exists), data-facility-id on each button, and the 300-site limit alert. Keyboard order follows visual order.

Tests: update the plan feature tests (FacilityPicker is exercised from PlanWorkspace.test.ts and siblings; add a FacilityPicker.test.ts if cleaner) to assert: on a landable non-ringed body with no sites, the Orbital tab lists Coriolis, Dodecahedron, Ocellus, Orbis with no paging control present; Asteroid Base appears only with has_rings; the Surface tab is disabled on a non-landable body; Both shows orbital sections before surface; search filters within the tab; no more than 6 preview requests are in flight. Update any Cypress planner spec selectors that relied on the paging buttons. Add a CHANGES.md entry. Run pnpm check, pnpm test and pnpm build in apps/web.
